title: Youjo Senki II

thread.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 • Youjo Senki II - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers enjoyed the episode’s humor and unexpected lighter moments.
Several commenters praised Tanya’s increasingly intense presence and strategic characterization.
Some called it one of the season’s strongest or best anime episodes.
Viewers liked the tension and political setup, while finding the leadership’s decisions frustrating or irrational.
Multiple commenters strongly criticized the government’s ambition and apparent disregard for practical consequences.

title: Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou

thread.title: Clevatess Season 2 • Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha Denshou - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers enjoyed the episode’s humor, especially the recurring physical comedy and Alicia’s reactions.
Alicia’s return to her familiar form and continued resilience were widely welcomed.
Several commenters found the darker atmosphere and horror elements entertaining.
The episode generated strong curiosity about the central mysteries, but many viewers felt the explanations were difficult to follow.
Some viewers complained that the episodes feel too short and leave them wanting more.
Fan-service drew enthusiasm from some commenters, while others treated it as excessive or distracting.

notes: The title clearly identifies Clevatess Season 2 and episode 9. I retrieved the thread page and visible discussion comments; Reddit’s rendered page did not expose a separate total-comment count, so num_comments reflects the 62 comments read. Opinions are paraphrased and spoiler-free.
